<!-- pr-reviewer: fd29e45be2a91b9d1dd0f19325d0c01d31e30c30 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - green on its own head, but red once merged with current main (`layout_page_tool`, inherited from the parent #1996).

**What looks good**
- The new assertions are structure only: containment in the screen, container and modal frame, and top-to-bottom stacking of labelled anchors. There are no pixel sizes or colours.
- No snapshot PNG changed, no product code changed, and no `Cargo.toml`, build.rs, `.github` or script change.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited, and the body carries `Process change: yes`, as upstream AGENTS.md requires. The process-file edits (`AGENTS.md` "A UI refit PR keeps its tests", `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`) come from the parent #1996, not from this PR's own commits. Beyond #1996 this PR adds only `page_layout.rs` and `docs/decisions/1991-window-layout-tests.md`.
- The stack note is correct: #1996 is still open at b94b2dc9b, which is an ancestor of this head. #1996 must merge first.
- It has a decision file and a `Fixes #1991` line. The body has a `Changelog: none` line.

**Results** (locally on macOS/Metal; no runner used)
- PR head: `cargo xtask gate test layout_window_` passed all 9. `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 870 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- Trial merge with `upstream/main` (clean, no conflicts): `camcraft-ui --lib` gave 881 passed and **1 failed**.
```
egui_app::tests::page_layout::layout_page_tool
panicked at crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs:48:13:
Tool page: no widget labelled "Edit"
```
- Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` on the merged tree: clean.

**Requested before merge**
1. After #1996 merges, refresh its (and so this PR's) `layout_page_tool` against current main. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs` still expects an "Edit" label on the Tool page, which main no longer renders. The test is #1996's, but this PR cannot merge while it is red (AGENTS.md "A UI refit PR keeps its tests"). Re-run `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` merged with main.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `assert_modal_layout` reads the modal rect from `ctx.memory(area_rect(Id::new("unsaved-prompt"|"fixture-library")))`, so it depends on those egui Area ids. A rename shows up as a clear "modal area is not laid out" panic, which is fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 271c7c1f38b7aeeed18ad4e1ffd00d411fc6e242 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge, after parent PR #1996.**

This review is for head `271c7c1f3`. The new commit since the last review (`9f5fbb3`) is a merge of `main` at `e3ca44fa7`. That merge had one conflict, which the author resolved by hand. Thus this review examined the remerge diff and did a full local build and test again.

**Conflict resolution (stock_fit.rs)**
- The resolution keeps the `main` version of `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_fit.rs`. The file is the same as on `main`: `stock_pane_delete` and its uniqueness check stay. All four stock-fit tests stay.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/1991-window-layout-tests.md` gives the reason for this resolution.

**What looks good**
- The change is in tests, docs and process files only. It does not change product code, posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. It does not change a snapshot PNG, a golden, a dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/`.
- The changes to the UI are test-only. No user sees a different UI, thus before/after screenshots are not necessary.
- The 8 new `layout_window_*` tests and `layout_window_debug_info` cover all the targets that #1991 names.
- The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` does not decrease. The diff adds `#[test]` lines and removes none.
- The PR body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The body ends with `Fixes #1991` and has a `Changelog:` line.
- NeoTech asked for a merge of `origin/main` into the branch. The head now contains `main` at `e3ca44fa7`, and GitHub shows MERGEABLE.

**Results, merged with main (local, upstream/main `e3ca44fa705d71438a8fd8a8efccbafcc2b6517f`)**

The head already contains this `main`, thus the trial merge was "Already up to date".

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | pass, 0 failed (8.5 min) |
| `ui lib` | 970 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `ui:boundary` / `boundary_picks` / `sinker_setup` / `tap_hand` / `theme_files` / `waterjet_tool` | 3 / 6 / 2 / 3 / 15 / 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | pass, 0 warnings |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib layout_` | 26 passed, 0 failed |

**Mutations (local, product code, then reverted)**
1. `unsaved_prompt.rs`: replace `set_max_width(360.0)` with `set_min_width(4000.0)`. Result: `layout_window_unsaved_prompt` is red ("Unsaved changes modal: [[-1367.0 319.0] - [2647.0 401.0]] leaves the screen").
2. `fixture_library_dialog.rs`: move the `Note` field above `Placed by` in the Save dialog. Result: `layout_window_fixture_library` is red ("\"Note\" (top 345) must be under \"Bottom centre\" (top 406)").
3. After the revert, all 26 `layout_` tests are green.

**Requested before merge**

None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Merge order: the branch contains the commits of the open parent PR #1996, and #1996 has the `conflicts` label now. Merge #1996 first, as the body says. If this PR merges first, it also merges all of #1996.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs` has 401 lines. This is at the 400-line limit. Put the next layout tests in a new file.
3. `page_layout::assert_shell_layout` does not do the old position checks for the `Operations`, `WCS`, `Machine`, `Post` and `Tool list` browser rows. `assert_shell_skeleton` still checks that these rows show. You can add them to the `in_browser` check at a later time.
4. The test counts in the PR body (`ui lib` 870 passed) are from an older `main`. This review found 970.
5. The PR is a draft now. The author sets it to ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7ebaf44eff351dfe1cdb5a72bee42d0d44ee41f9 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The tests are good and all checks pass. Two small items remain: a provenance line in the new module, and a PR body that does not agree with this head.

This review is for head `7ebaf44ef`. The new commit since the last review (`43b052a88`) is a merge of `main` at `3e47b898b`. The author resolved a conflict by hand: the window and modal tests moved from `page_layout.rs` to a new module, `page_layout_windows.rs`. Thus this review examined the full diff again and did a full local build and test.

**What looks good**
- The merge keeps `page_layout.rs` the same as on `main`. The PR diff against `main` has 3 files only: `tests.rs` (one `mod` line), the new `page_layout_windows.rs` (176 lines), and the decision record.
- The 8 new tests cover all windows and modals that #1991 lists: Post refused, the unsaved prompt, the fixture library (save and insert), vise, plate, accessory, the Machines pane, and the G-code window.
- The tests use the coarse law only: the frame is inside the screen, and the anchors are inside the frame and go from top to bottom. The modal helper reads the modal rectangle from its egui area and checks the dismiss button against the modal. There are no pixel sizes or colours.
- The split keeps both modules below the file size limit. The decision record has a note that tells about the split.
- No product code, snapshot PNG, golden, dependency, `build.rs`, script or workflow changes. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The PR changes no posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review. The PR changes no rendered UI, thus before/after screenshots do not apply.

**Results, merged with main (locally)**

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2068`. No GitHub runner was used. The trial merge with `upstream/main` `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d` gave "Already up to date": the PR already contains that commit.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed; 9 steps, 0 failed |
| UI build (`--no-run`, lib and 7 suites) | Passed |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | 1061 passed; 0 failed; 6 release snapshot tests ignored |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 7 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_example` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 15 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

All 8 tests in `page_layout_windows` passed. `layout_window_debug_info` and `layout_window_gcode_wrap_and_trace` in `page_layout.rs` also passed. I did not run mutations (not a safety-tier review). No golden moved.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout_windows.rs:1` - The new module has no provenance line. AGENTS.md ("Every module carries a one-line provenance comment: what it implements and from which public source it was specced") requires one. Before the split, these tests were in `page_layout.rs`, which has one. Add a line to the module comment, for example: `//! #1991. Provenance: our own layout law over the egui_kittest AccessKit tree; no HSMWorks material involved.`
2. PR body - The body does not agree with this head. Correct these items:
   - `Process change: yes`: the diff against `main` changes no process file. With this line, the merging session runs `cargo xtask process-bump` and writes a process announcement on #681 for no process change. Remove the line.
   - `Stacked on #1996 (merge #1996 first)` and the "Overlaps" section: #1996 is merged. Remove them.
   - "What changed" says that the helpers and tests are in `page_layout.rs` and that `layout_window_debug_info` is simplified. On this head, the tests are in `page_layout_windows.rs` and `page_layout.rs` does not change. "Tests" gives 9 named tests and old counts (870 passed). Give the 8 tests and the current results.

   This is a body edit only. It does not change the head.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `docs/decisions/1991-window-layout-tests.md:5` - Item 1 still tells the old choice (extend `page_layout.rs`; dropped: a second file). The note of 2026-11-18 at the end supersedes it. When the gathered record goes into `RECOMMENDED.md`, a reader can see two opposite choices. Think about a change of item 1 to tell the current choice.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout_windows.rs:94` - `remove_dir_all` does not run when an assertion before it fails. A failed run keeps the temporary fixture-library folder. This is a small item in a test only.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout_windows.rs:147-153` - The test uses `super::super::layout::apply` and `super::layout::leaf_rect`. These are two different modules (the product `layout` and the test `layout`). A short comment can prevent confusion.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
